thread:
lucy (Accounting): Incoming invoice INV-MS-5580 from MatrixScale dated 2026-08-15 for $20,400. PDF has no PO. AP auto-match failed, putting on hold.
omar (Procurement): can you upload the PDF?
lucy (Accounting): uploaded INV-MS-5580.pdf
omar (Procurement): running PO lookup... `select po_id,vendor,amount from pos where vendor ilike '%matrixscale%'` -> PO-812233 for MatrixScale $18,000 created 2026-03-01. amount mismatch $2,400.
diego (Platform): $2,400 looks like the ingress/data-transfer surcharge from the Aug ramp. did platform approve that?
diego (Platform): we approved scale-up but not transfer surcharges. that should have been flagged as billable only with pre-approval.
matrixscale (vendor): MatrixScale: the $2,400 is for 30TB data egress at $80/TB per contract appendix. we billed per appendix B.
carol (Vendor Relations): vendor contract notes appendix B, but I don't see a sign-off for egress for this period. can you point to an email approval?
emily (Finance Dir): quick note: invoices >$15k need PO match + finance approval if variance >10%. This is >10% variance on PO. I'll need to sign off if procurement routes an amendment.
omar (Procurement): options: (1) ask vendor to re-issue invoice referencing PO-812233 for $18,000 and send separate invoice for disputed $2,400; (2) create PO-812233-AMD for $2,400 and route to emily for approval; (3) partial payment for $18k and hold $2,400 pending dispute resolution.
lucy (Accounting): AP preference is vendor reissue referencing PO so matching is clean. if vendor won't, we'll need amendment and approval chain.
diego (Platform): I can sign off on the $2,400 if we have a post-facto approval doc AND a usage breakdown showing 30TB on those dates. otherwise deny.
carol (Vendor Relations): opening ticket V-1248 with MatrixScale requesting itemized transfer logs and asking them to reissue invoice referencing PO-812233 or split the invoice. cc: lucy, omar, diego.
matrixscale (vendor): MatrixScale support: we can split the invoice and reissue today. we'll provide transfer logs and contract appendix reference. we can also offer 1% early-pay discount on the full amount if you accept current invoice.
emily (Finance Dir): do not accept full invoice + discount until we confirm the charge is authorized. prefer reissue/split so AP can process matched portion.
ap-bot: Reminder - invoices placed on hold require resolution within 10 business days to avoid escalation.
lucy (Accounting): created payment hold HOLD-2235 for INV-MS-5580, reason: missing PO + variance. due date on invoice 2026-09-14.
omar (Procurement): ticket V-1248 created: "Request reissue INV-MS-5580 referencing PO-812233 or split disputed egress charges; provide transfer logs and contract appendix." cc: diego, emily.
matrixscale (vendor): confirmed 12 will reissue matched invoice for $18,000 referencing PO-812233 and a separate invoice INV-MS-5580-EGR for $2,400 with transfer logs attached by EOD.
diego (Platform): once we get logs i'll review and either approve the amendment or reject the egress invoice.
lucy (Accounting): will remove hold and process the $18k when reissued invoice with PO is received. leaving thread open until both items resolved. :white_check_mark:
